about: The photoreal library beyond Poly Haven (apps/gate/scripts/build-library.mjs): for each kind, the model drawn by default ("use", else the Poly Haven pick from fetch-models.mjs) and variants chosen by the words in an object's label. Every model is CC0, CC-BY or CC-BY-SA (Rocketbox: MIT); credits in "models", shown at /models/credits.html.
